$description: Contents of markers.json: the persisted marker state. Field-for-field mirror of specs/markers/state.qnt with model ints realized as op-log hex strings.

markers.description: Markers in run order. Id strings pass through verbatim — the schema judges shape, never id validity.

entries.description: The operation's kept entry ids, run order.

kind.description: The operation's kind: a creation, a recording or a removal (G-operation).

reverts.description: The reverts undo recorded against the operation while it is undone.

target.description: The change the operation acted on: the created change, the recorded-into node or the removed change.

pos.description: How many markers are applied: markers before it are applied, markers from it onward are the undone tail. 0 at init. The 0 <= pos <= length rule is cross-field and lives with the model invariants and the marker guards.

title: Marker file
